 def code_changes():
-    return load(PACKAGE / 'expected-changes.json')['code']
+    """Exact issue471 formatting successor; no other source or gate waiver."""
+    rows = load(PACKAGE / 'expected-changes.json')['code']
+    acceptance = load('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-232-root-formatting-acceptance-20261012.json')
+    assert acceptance['status'] == 'accepted_exact_issue471_formatting_successor'
+    assert acceptance['issue'] == 471 and acceptance['target_sha256'] == TARGET_SHA
+    verify(acceptance['handoff']['path'], acceptance['handoff'])
+    assert acceptance['semantic_review']['accepted'] is True
+    assert acceptance['bridge']['directory'] == str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
+    for item in acceptance['bridge']['files']:
+        verify(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / safe_relative(item['relative_path']), item)
+    expected = {'src/pathwaymech/ecocyc_complex.py', 'src/pathwaymech/identifiers.py',
+                'tests/test_ecocyc_complex_authority.py'}
+    changes = acceptance['changes']
+    assert len(changes) == 3 and {r['relative_path'] for r in changes} == expected
+    by_path = {r['relative_path']: r for r in rows}
+    for item in changes:
+        relative = item['relative_path']
+        prior = by_path[relative]
+        assert {k: prior['after'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')} == {
+            k: item['before'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
+        for key in ('before', 'after'):
+            verify(item[key]['path'], item[key])
+        assert item['after']['path'] == str(Path(
+            '/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-232-formatting-successor-20261012/candidate') / relative)
+        prior['after'] = item['after']
+    return rows
